get.description:
Called by the app at launch and when it comes back to the foreground, before any sign-in.
`update_required`: the app blocks until the update is installed; `update_available`: it
suggests it once.

parameters.description: Platform of the installed app (`android` also covers Android TV).

parameters.description: Build number of the installed app (`CFBundleVersion` on iOS, `versionCode` on Android).

minimum_build.description: Installs older than this build must update (null: none required).

update_url.description: Page where the update is installed: the site's install page (no Play Store).

Items carry their title logo (`logo_url`), unlike other lists.

get.description:
First page of movies, TV shows and people, grouped. Use the per-type search for more.
Movies and TV shows respect the active profile's age limit.

With a filter (genre, years, rating) or another order than relevance, movies and TV shows
are the matching titles among the first 60 results of each, sorted; people are only
returned without a filter.

parameters.name: X-Profile-Id
parameters.description: Active profile id: its age limit is applied.

Movies and TV shows with a filter (genre, years, rating) or another order than relevance:
the matching titles among the first 60 results, sorted, in a single page. Filters and order
don't apply to people.

post.description:
Deletes the account, its profiles, their list, progress and history, and signs out every
device. Cannot be undone. The password is sent in the body (POST, not DELETE: never a
secret in a URL).

Sends a JSON file with the account, profiles, list, progress and devices to the account's
address (GDPR right of access and portability). Limited to 3 per hour.
post.summary: E-mail a copy of the account's data

delete.description:
Revokes one of the account's tokens (a TV, a phone…). To sign out the current device, use

AppUpdateStatus.description:
What an installed app should do about updates. | | |---| | `up_to_date`
Latest version installed. | | `update_available`
A newer version exists: suggest it. | | `update_required`
The installed version is older than a required release: block until updated. |
AppUpdateStatus.title: AppUpdateStatus

id.description: Value to store in the profile's `avatar`.

pixels.description: Pixel-art rows, top to bottom; each character is a palette key, "." is transparent.

user_code.description: Code shown on the TV ("K7F-29Q"; dash and case don't matter).

device_code.description: `device_code` returned by POST /auth/device. Secret: keep it on the TV.

name.description: Device name given at sign-in, e.g. "Vixeo TV" or "iPhone".

expires_at.description: After this date the device has to sign in again.

device_name.description: Shown on the phone before approving, and used as the token name ("Vixeo TV").

| | `channel`
Live TV channel (FAST). | | `video`

device_name.description: Free label identifying the device, e.g. "Pixel 8" or "Salon TV".

date.description: Release date (movie) or first air date (TV show), YYYY-MM-DD.

poster_url.description: Poster, w342. Build other sizes with `poster_path` (see /catalog/config).

logo_url.description: Title logo (transparent PNG, w500). Home rows only: null elsewhere (the title page has it) or when TMDb has none.

certification.description: Raw certification, French if available, else American ("12", "PG-13").

age_rating.description: Minimum age derived from the certification (0 = all audiences). Null if unknown.

logo_path.description: Title logo (transparent PNG, w500), French if available. Null: write the title.

logo_aspect_ratio.description: Logo width / height, to size it before it loads.

textless_backdrop_path.description: Backdrop without text (to show under the logo), w1280. Null: use `backdrop_url`.

cast.description: Main cast (20 max), in billing order.

ParentalPinRequest.description:
Set or change (PUT /pin) or remove (POST /disable) the parental PIN. Once a PIN exists, the current
PIN or the account password is needed (password = "code oublié").

current_pin.description: Current parental PIN. Required when one is set, unless `password` is given.

password.description: Account password, if the parental PIN was forgotten.

ParentalPinRequest.title: ParentalPinRequest

filmography.description: Titles as cast member, most recent first (100 max).

PosterFormat.description:
How a profile wants catalog titles drawn in rows and grids. | | |---| | `portrait`
Vertical poster (2:3). Default. | | `landscape`
Horizontal image (16:9). |
PosterFormat.title: PosterFormat

progress.description: Between 0 and 1, null if the duration is unknown (progress bar).

avatar.description: Avatar id from GET /avatars. Null = initial letter.

poster_format.description:
How titles are drawn in rows and grids. Default `portrait`. | | |---| | `portrait`
Vertical poster (2:3). Default. | | `landscape`
Horizontal image (16:9). |

is_kid.description: Kid profile. Without `max_age_rating`, its age limit is 10.

max_age_rating.description: Maximum age rating allowed for this profile (e.g. 12, 16). Null = no limit.

allow_unrated.description: With an age limit, also show titles whose age rating is unknown. Default false.

locked_sources.description: Sources or folders hidden on this profile, e.g. "jellyfin:abc" or "jellyfin:abc#Films" (100 max).

pin.description: 4-digit PIN protecting the profile. Send null to remove it.

parental_pin.description: Parental PIN: required (when parental control is on) to create a profile or change its restrictions.

current_pin.description: Current PIN of the profile: required to change or remove it, unless `parental_pin` is given.

effective_max_age_rating.description: Age limit actually applied (kid profile without `max_age_rating`: 10). Null = no limit.

locked_sources.description: Sources / folders the app must hide on this profile.

device_name.description: Free label identifying the device, e.g. "Pixel 8" or "Salon TV".
Free label identifying the device, e.g. "Pixel 8" or "Salon TV".

| | `rating`
| | `recent`

|
SearchSort.title: SearchSort

certification.description: Raw certification, French if available, else American ("12", "TV-MA").

age_rating.description: Minimum age derived from the certification (0 = all audiences). Null if unknown.

logo_path.description: Title logo (transparent PNG, w500), French if available. Null: write the title.

logo_aspect_ratio.description: Logo width / height, to size it before it loads.

textless_backdrop_path.description: Backdrop without text (to show under the logo), w1280. Null: use `backdrop_url`.

cast.description: Main cast over all seasons (20 max).

changes.description: Changes made on the device since its last push (500 max, applied in order).

item_id.description: Item id inside the source, e.g. "movie:550", "episode:1399:1:3".

title.description: Display title (for an episode: the episode name).

parent_item_id.description: For an episode: item_id of its TV show.

favorite.description: Favorite added or removed. At least one of favorite, progress, watched is required.

at.description: When the change happened on the device (ISO 8601).

continue_watching.description: false = removed from "Continuer à regarder" (the position is kept for resuming).

watched.description: Marked as watched or not watched.
